column3: The meltwater is rising and\nour sandbags are gone.{page_break}Could you spare 150 coins\nfor more?{end_now}
Thank you. The lower\nstreets will hold a while\nlonger.{end_wait}
I understand. We'll keep\nstacking what we have.{end_wait}
The new bags are holding.\nThank you, stranger.{end_wait}
No coins to spare? Neither\ndo we. Stay safe.{end_wait}
Take it, and keep the water\nout of the houses.{end_wait}

We came for the festival,
but now no ship will sail
and our money's gone.{page_break}Could you lend us 400 coins
to get home?{end_now}
I understand. Everyone's\nshort on coins now.{end_wait}
We're leaving at dawn.\nBless you, young warrior.{end_wait}
No coins to spare? Neither\ndo we. Safe travels,\nwarrior.{end_wait}
Take it, and get your\nfamily home.{end_wait}
